letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise feels brighter when I think of you—whether the Dubai dunes glisten or Ahmedabad’s monsoon breezes dance. I’m still amazed that just a few months ago we whispered “I do” on that golden February day, and now our love feels timeless. Your laughter is my favorite soundtrack, your smile my daily sunrise, and your hand the compass that guides me home. Thank you for being my endless adventure, my sweet cutie, and the heart that makes every moment magical.
poem:
In desert heat or monsoon rain,  
Your love’s the rhythm in my vein.  
Across two cities, hearts entwine,  
Forever yours, forever mine.
